title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
contentSnippet: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

title: Amazon S3 Tables now offer managed migration of Apache Hive tables to Apache Iceberg
contentSnippet: You can now migrate existing Apache Hive datasets in Amazon S3 to fully managed Apache Iceberg tables in Amazon S3 Tables, with no pipelines to build or compute to provision, while production workloads keep running.

title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.

title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents
contentSnippet: Personal AI agents have changed how users interact with the web, blurring the lines between automated and human traffic. Learn how Cloudflare gives site owners visibility and control to manage personal agent access.
